description: Should I pay this x402 endpoint? Verdict pay/caution/block/cannot_pay with reasons: price vs your maxUsd and decoy prices, asset/network, payTo screened against OFAC SDN, Circle/Tether freezes and exploit/phishing/mixer labels, expected payTo, Bazaar track record, broken payment terms. Returns the payment option a standard client would sign. Price: $0.003 USDC per call, paid with x402 on Base.

expectPayTo.description: Optional: the payTo address you expect; any other -> block

maxUsd.description: Your budget for this one payment in USD (default 1); higher price -> block

url.description: Full URL of the x402 endpoint you are about to pay, with its query string

name: safepay_preflight
